findings.message: 13 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 12 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Barbearia em Gravatá, PE" above "A arte do ritual."; "Combos" above "Corte + barba simples"; "Agendar este serviço" above "R$ 79,90"; "Camuflagem barba" above "Boas mãos. Boas histórias."; "Agendar este serviço" above "Damião"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 2 tiny uppercase letter-spaced label(s): "SR. NAVALHA", "ESPELHO VIVO"
findings.fix: Prefer sentence case at body size.
Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: 71 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): button.mirror-choice 389px | button.mirror-choice 389px | button.mirror-choice 389px | button.mirror-choice 389px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 90 characters per line.
1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: nav → rgba(23, 22, 21, 0.15) 0px 15px 40px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "A casa" (screen 1, 50% hidden); "Rituais & serviços" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "O trabalho" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Produtos" (screen 1, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Corte + barba simples" → 3 lines (4 words, 26px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 3 large-set statement(s) run past 4 lines at 390px: "“Excelente! Todos os funcionários são mu…" → 7 lines at 24px; "“Atendimento excepcional! A equipe é sup…" → 9 lines at 24px; "“Excelente! Todos os funcionários são mu…" → 7 lines at 24px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.
